integrity: Analytic proof supplies all-dimension global optimization, equality cases and asymptotic limit. Finite code is corroborative, not an infinite certificate; scientific priority has not been independently verified.
scientific_limitations: Applies to equal-weight symmetric one-excitation/one-hole qubit cats with integer dimension n>=4, not arbitrary symmetric states; nontrivial exact optimizers specified by unique roots. The general symmetry/product optimization tools in earlier literature are credited. Equivalent reparameterizations in published literature remain a possible priority risk.
title: Dimension-six bifurcation of closest product states for complementary Dicke cats
